verdict.rationale: Kit ships a first-party remote MCP server that exposes a creator's account (subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments) to AI clients with read/write access. Its docs explicitly say natural-language prompts like "draft a broadcast to my new subscribers from this week" become real account actions. Natural-language operation requires bringing an external MCP-compatible AI client. missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language interface, independent or hands-on corroboration that NL commands work reliably, documentation of which actions and limits apply via the MCP.
